_about: SYNTHETIC fixture for test_bundle_multifile.py and test_judge_e2e.py. It reproduces the SHAPE of the PR #139 range (7 code/doc files + 5 telemetry .jsonl, one file > 400 lines, > 60k chars in full) and the 09-27 deep-read-gate regression log row, without pinning any commit of this repo's history. No file content here is copied from the real files except the four reviewer quotes the regression needs (engineering text, no people, no events). fixture_repo.py materialises it as a throwaway git repo: base -> head (the range) -> small (a one-file range). A line '@@PAD n@@' expands to n deterministic filler lines.
